name: quarter-hour-reminders
description: Playful reminders at every quarter-hour mark: web app plus an always-on-top desktop alert.

scripts.check: node --check schedule.js && node --check app.js && node --check serve.js && node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --test
scripts.package:mac: electron-packager . "Quarter-Hour Reminders" --platform=darwin --arch=$(uname -m | sed s/x86_64/x64/) --out=dist --overwrite --icon=build/icon.icns --app-bundle-id=com.votuantu.quarterhourreminders --ignore="^/dist" --ignore="^/\.claude" --ignore="^/build" --ignore="^/serve\.js$" --ignore="\.test\.js$" && codesign --force --deep --sign - "dist/Quarter-Hour Reminders-darwin-$(uname -m | sed s/x86_64/x64/)/Quarter-Hour Reminders.app"
